sources.supports: Unreported income outside a compliance programme: accuracy-related penalty of 20% of the underpaid tax.

sources.title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
sources.locator: Sections 'Federal Mandate...', 'Who Must File?', 'What if I don't file?'
quotes: Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP).
the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual
risk having their currency or monetary instruments forfeited and seized
sources.supports: Carrying, mailing or shipping more than $10,000 in currency or monetary instruments into the U.S. must be reported (FinCEN Form 105); the threshold applies to a family or group together; unreported cash can be seized.
